_comment_css: CSS added at S9 (CAPACITÉS). Until then this gate was blind to stylesheets, and that is exactly how feature-info-gallery.css came to be a byte-identical concatenation of poi-accordion-gallery.css + poi-lightbox.css, all three loaded together: ~630 lines shipped twice with no gate able to see it (purgecss only reports UNREFERENCED selectors, and all three files were referenced). Measured before wiring: 6.15 % duplicated CSS — above this threshold, so the purge had to come first; after it, 1.82 %.
